messages.subject: [VOTE] Airflow Providers, release preparation date 2026-10-14
messages.body:
Hey all,

I have just cut the new wave Airflow Providers packages with release
preparation date 2026-10-14. This email is calling a vote on the
release,
which will last for 72 hours - which means that it will end on
2026-10-17 14:46 UTC and until 3 binding +1 votes have been received.

Consider this my (binding) +1.

This is an ad-hoc wave that re-cuts the four providers excluded from
the 2026-10-06 wave, now that the regressions found during that vote
are fixed:

* amazon 9.38.0rc2 - fixes the AWS auth manager login failure with IAM
Identity Center
* dbt.cloud 4.11.0rc2 - fixes deferred tasks failing with tenacity retry_args
* google 22.7.0rc2 - fixes GKE operator imports with older
cncf-kubernetes providers
* common.ai 1.0.0rc1 - the first stable release of the provider (it
was 0.11.0rc1 in the previous wave). It contains breaking changes,
each with migration notes in the changelog.

common.compat 1.22.0rc1 is also included, because the new EMR
Serverless session operator in amazon needs it.

Airflow Providers are available at:
https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/airflow/providers/2026-10-14

*apache-airflow-providers-2026-10-14-source.tar.gz* is the full source
tarball of airflow repo - snapshot taken at the moment of provider's
release.

*apache-airflow-providers-<PROVIDER>-*.tar.gz* are the convenience
python "sdist" distributions that we publish in PyPI

*apache_airflow_providers_<PROVIDER>-*.whl are the convenience Python
"wheel" distributions that we publish in PyPI.

The test procedure for PMC members is described in
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/dev/README_RELEASE_PROVIDERS.md#verify-the-release-candidate-by-pmc-members

The test procedure for and Contributors who would like to test this RC
is described in:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/dev/README_RELEASE_PROVIDERS.md#verify-the-release-candidate-by-contributors


Public keys are available at:
https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/release/airflow/KEYS

Please vote accordingly:

[ ] +1 approve
[ ] +0 no opinion
[ ] -1 disapprove with the reason

Only votes from PMC members are binding, but members of the community are
encouraged to test the release and vote with "(non-binding)".

Please note that the version number excludes the 'rcX' string.
This will allow us to rename the artifact without modifying
the artifact checksums when we actually release it.

The status of testing the providers by the community is kept here:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/74741

The issue is also the easiest way to see important PRs included in the
RC candidates.
Detailed changelog for the providers will be published in the
documentation after the
RC candidates are released.

You can find the RC packages in PyPI following these links:

https://pypi.org/project/apache-airflow-providers-amazon/9.38.0rc2/
https://pypi.org/project/apache-airflow-providers-common-ai/1.0.0rc1/
https://pypi.org/project/apache-airflow-providers-common-compat/1.22.0rc1/
https://pypi.org/project/apache-airflow-providers-dbt-cloud/4.11.0rc2/
https://pypi.org/project/apache-airflow-providers-google/22.7.0rc2/

Cheers,
Jarek Potiuk

messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] Airflow Providers, release preparation date 2026-10-14
messages.body:
+1 (non-binding) for amazon 9.38.0rc2.

Verified checksums and signatures, and that the wheel contents match the RC
tag and the PyPI rc2 wheel.

Tested the IAM Identity Center login fix (#74529) end to end on Airflow
3.3.2 / Python 3.12: AWS auth manager over HTTPS, a SAML IdP on a different
site, and headless Chrome. On rc1, the IdP's cross-site POST to
/auth/login_callback returns 401 "No login in progress"; on rc2, the login
completes (303) and /ui/auth/me returns 200.

Thanks,
Aaron

messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] Airflow Providers, release preparation date 2026-10-14
messages.body:
+1 (binding) -- although if possible we could do rc2 with Pydantic Skills
bug fix.

Checked for all five providers: SVN files, signatures, checksums, licences
(RAT) and reproducible builds. A rebuild from the providers/2026-10-14 tag
gave byte-identical wheels, sdists and source tarball.

I also tested common.ai 1.0.0rc1 from PyPI on Airflow 3.3.2 (and 2.11.2 for
the Airflow 2 path), live against real models and Modal sandboxes. Details
are in #74741.

One thing I found that is not a regression to 0.10.0 but still a bug: the
`skills` extra allows pydantic-ai-skills 2.x, which dropped the class
`AgentSkillsToolset` wraps, so a fresh `[skills]` install fails at run
time. 0.10.0 has the same problem. The fix (cap below 2) is in #74899 and
can go out in 1.0.1, so I don't think it should hold this wave but if
possible we can fix it and release it in 1.0.0 too.

Regards,
Kaxil
